objective: Determine whether consensus counts are inflated by adjacent M15 repeats and whether causal first-signal cooldowns preserve lift at independently usable density.

authority.source: accepted XM BTCUSD# closed-bar OHLC only

selection: For each schedule and direction in chronological order, accept a consensus event only when decision_time >= last accepted decision_time + cooldown. Cooldown carries across calendar-month boundaries. No label is used.
outputs: accepted months with at least 10 events
label lift and improvement versus raw consensus
prohibitions: no Shadow, Discord, MT5 orders, live-ready or final signal
